test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 17 Jul 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Simplify,

(x⁴ - 2x² + 1)/(x² - 2x + 1)
solution:
**Formula used:**

(a - b)² = a² + b² - 2ab

(a² - b²) = (a + b) × (a - b)

(a + b)2 = a2 + b2 + 2ab

**Calculation:**

(x⁴ - 2x² + 1)/(x² - 2x + 1)

⇒ {(x²)² + 1 - 2 × (x²) × 1}/(x - 1)²

⇒ (x² - 1)²/(x - 1)²

⇒ {(x + 1)²(x - 1)²}/(x - 1)²

⇒ (x + 1)2 = x2 + 2x + 1

**∴ The correct option is 3.**
